subject: Receiving error when including index.html script in apps directory

messages.author: d6ffe8b5633d6bb1
messages.subject: Receiving error when including index.html script in apps directory
parts:
Hello,

I configured my shiny-server.conf file to look for my Shiny apps in /var/shiny-server/www/apps as such:

  location / {
    site_dir /var/shiny-server/www/apps/;
        ...

When I create an index.html file in the /var/shiny-server/www/apps/ directory, however, instead of displaying the contents of index.html, I receive this error:
   
     An error has occurred: {"code":"ECONNRESET"}

My goal is to create an HTML/CSS-customized landing page for my dashboards. From the configuration doc here, it's supposed to read the index.html file if present, otherwise it will show a default index page. In my case, it's presenting me the error above. How can I rectify this issue?

Thanks for your help!

Alan

messages.subject: Re: Receiving error when including index.html script in apps directory
parts:
I think I misunderstood your directory structure. If the app you are working on is /var/shiny-server/www/apps/myapp you need a myapp/www directory for html files as stated in http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#html-ui

Also, I would suggest getting your app working locally before moving it to server. Easier to debug.

parts:
Please try updating Shiny Server to a more recent version, I believe this is an incompatibility between Shiny Server 0.3.4 and Node 10.x that was fixed in Shiny Server 0.3.5.

You should be able to update by doing

sudo npm install -g shiny-server
sudo restart shiny-server
